title: Glutamate: research frontiers (R-10009)
description: Glutamate is a neurotransmitter of the nervous system. Its role: the brain’s primary excitatory neurotransmitter. Key fact: the most prevalent excitatory transmitter in the brain. Current research probes Glutamate with ever finer tools, from single-cell recording to whole-brain imaging. Closely associated with excitation, learning, and memory.
